title: Classify only at a role-less tick's first dispatch
description: Triaged 2026-09-23 from wne's close-out. wne's done says Jev is asked ONCE per tick and later passes read the record. c0102b2d: a later attempt that finds no record must not ask - asking then makes a re-derivation reach a different dispatch than the run it reconstructs (axiom 1).
acceptance_criteria: A later attempt of a tick with no classification record does not call the classifier and falls back as the policy says; a test drives it; and the full suites pass
